BlockConfigColumn.description: One column of an `objectList` entry: a named input on every row.

BlockConfigField.description: One editable config field, in the order the inspector renders it, discriminated on `control`.

BlockConfigOption.description: One choice of a `select` or `segmented` field. `requires` is the run context the choice needs beyond the block's own, while the field is shown and holds it.

BlockOutputDeclaration.description: A value a block writes for later blocks. `fixed` writes `key`; `authored` writes the name the node holds in its `fromField` config field.

BlockOutputHandle.description: One way a run can leave a block. `warnIfUnconnected` is `true`, or the condition under which the builder warns while the exit is unconnected.

BotFlavour.description: Which bot application the dashboard is connected to, read off its name.

BotIdentity.description: The bot account the dashboard is connected to. Every field but `ready` is null while the gateway is still connecting; show the bundled branding then.

CohortKey.description: A band of members by XP within this server, least to most active. `topOnePercent` is a spotlight inside `topQuarter`, not a fifth band, so the counts do not sum.

DiscordMessage.description: A Discord message: optional plain text above up to ten embeds. A picture is an upload (`upload:<uuid>`), an http(s) link, or text holding a token; the server judges its form, and the rules spanning parts, when it re-checks the node.

FlowDraftSave.description: The caller's canvas. `baseUpdatedAt` is the flow version it was loaded from.

FlowDraftSummary.description: One operator's draft of a flow, without its graph. `mine` is the caller's own; `flowSavedSince` means the flow was saved after the draft was started.

FlowGroup.description: `resolution` is required when the moving flow declares resources. `newJourneyKey` is required when the target flow is on no journey yet, so one is created.

FlowJourneyMembership.description: The journey a flow sits in, present for every flow that resolves to one. Group rows on `memberCount > 1`, not on this being present: 1 is the implicit journey a lone flow gets. `installState` says install has run over the declared resources, read from the binding table — not that every channel still exists. `installedKeys` are the keys with a live binding, which must stop following their resource name.

FlowNextRuns.description: When each of the flow's schedules next fires, keyed by node id (an ISO instant each). Only schedules with a next time are listed, so it is empty for a switched-off flow. `timeZone` is the zone the times were worked out in.

FlowSavedAsDraft.description: The flow is live and the graph was incomplete or waits on its install, so it went to the saver's draft and the flow is untouched. `draft.issues` are what the canvas shows; `uninstalled` names the declared resources the graph picks that are not in the server yet.

FlowSavedToFlow.description: The save landed on the flow. The saver's own draft, if they had one, is gone.

FlowSummary.description: One row of the flows list, without the graph. `issueCount` above 0 means the flow is incomplete: saved, but refused if switched on.

FlowUpdate.description: A partial update: send only what changed. `baseUpdatedAt` is the flow version the sent graph was edited from, recorded if the save lands as a draft.

FlowValidationIssue.description: One problem with a graph. `nodeId` names the node it is on and `field` the dotted path into its config (e.g. `fields.0.name`); a problem with the graph as a whole has neither.

GroupPreview.description: What grouping would do. `destination` is null when the target flow is on no journey yet, so one would be created. `orphaned` are the live resources "leave" would strand. `sharedTicketTypes` are ticket types both sides declare, which a merge folds into the destination's.

GuildObjectOwner.description: Who already holds a channel, category or role: a journey (by key) or the ticket system. `label` names the owner for the operator.

GuildSettings.description: Staff roles, as saved. `staffRoles` names the ids that still resolve to a role and can be shorter than `staffRoleIds`, since a deleted role stays saved: render from `staffRoleIds`, label from `staffRoles`. `timeZone` is the picked IANA zone, null until someone picks one; `defaultTimeZone` is the zone an unpicked server runs on.

GuildUploadListing.description: A picture kept for this server's messages, without its bytes, and every place a saved flow or a draft shows it — empty when nothing does, so it may be deleted.

Health.description: The web server is up. `time` is the server's clock, as ISO.

InstallPlan.description: What installing would do, item by item, unchanged items included. `applicable` is false when any blocker or blocked item stands in the way; the install re-checks it regardless.

JourneyDrift.description: What a journey installed that no longer matches what it declares (`drifted`), what it checked and found matching (`cleanKeys`), what it could not compare (`unchecked`), and what it installed and no longer declares (`orphans`).

JourneySummary.description: One journey, without its declarations, and the flows attached to it.

JourneyUpdate.description: A partial update: send only what changed. `description: null` clears it. `resources` replaces the whole list.

LevelingActivityBucket.description: One bar of the activity chart. `activityDate` is the day, or the first day of the week.

LevelingActivityChart.description: The activity chart. The period decides whether a bar is a day or a week.

LevelingActivitySummary.description: What a member did over a window, counted.

LevelingCohortProgressionPoint.description: How long a cohort took to reach a level. `thin` means too few members to call it typical.

LevelingCohortSummary.description: One cohort. `medianActiveDays` counts days a member earned something, not days since joining.

LevelingInsightsBody.description: The guild-wide insights report. `topLevel` is null when nobody has earned anything, and can pass the end of `levelReach` — `levelReachTruncated` says when. `xpDistribution` is null with no XP to describe. `computedAt` is ISO; `cached` means it came from the five-minute cache.

LevelingLevelReachPoint.description: How many members ever reached a level. `percentReached` is 0–100 of tracked members.

LevelingListResult.description: The leaderboard, capped. `truncated` means more members rank than are listed; `totalRankedMembers` is the whole server either way. `enabled` is whether leveling is on.

LevelingMember.description: A member as Discord knows them now. `avatarUrl` is null when they have no avatar.

LevelingRankingRow.description: A row on the leaderboard. `member` is null when they have left the server but still hold XP.

LevelingUserDetail.description: One member's level, XP and activity. A member with no progress is level 1 with nothing recorded, not a 404. `statsPeriod` is the window actually aggregated.

LevelingUserMetrics.description: The figures the stats card shows. Timestamps are ISO, null when never.

NodeDescriptor.description: Everything the Flow Builder draws a block from: its palette entry, its card, its inspector form and its exits. The block's config schema stays on the server.

PermissionIntent.description: This audience gets this access. `roleIds` names the roles for a `roles` audience — a snowflake, or `resource:<key>` for a role the same journey declares — and must not be empty there.

ResourceDeclaration.description: A resource a journey needs, named by a key stable across servers. `defaultName` is stored as Discord will hold it: a text channel lowercased, whitespace hyphenated; for a `ticketType` it is the type's label, trimmed. `adoptDiscordId` adopts something that already exists instead of creating it. `ticketType` holds a ticket type's settings, and only a `ticketType` resource carries it.

TicketActionResult.description: The ticket after a lifecycle action. `syncWarning` is set when the ticket changed and its channel did not follow — on a close, that the subject may still be able to read it. Show it.

TicketCounts.description: The server's ticket totals, whatever the list is filtered to.

TicketDetail.description: One ticket in full: the list row plus its reason and timeline. The conversation is not here; it lives in the Discord channel.

TicketParticipant.description: A person on a ticket, as the row recorded them. Both names are null on a row written before names were recorded; show the id then.
